purpose: Define per-peer/session/route bounds, malformed-request controls and temporary blocking before expensive application processing.

topics.name: Protocol Rate and Abuse Gate
topics.purpose: Define per-peer/session/route bounds, malformed-request controls and temporary blocking before expensive application processing.

semantics.scope_rule: Rate limit binds exact peer/session/route/protocol scope.
semantics.malformed_rule: Repeated malformed traffic may trigger bounded abuse policy.
semantics.block_rule: Temporary block/quarantine state is explicit and expires/revokes according to profile.
semantics.identity_rule: IP address alone is not always semantic peer identity; transport metadata may still be used as a bounded network defense dimension.
semantics.authorization_rule: Passing abuse gate does not grant application authorization.
semantics.failure_rule: Rate-limited requests do not masquerade as accepted application operations.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: IP permanently blacklisted as user identity without policy

references.purpose: Abuse gate protects protocol parse/application boundary.
